SQL_DOC.P_SQL: UPDATE KEPMDCP08 SET PAY_CND_CD = $V_PAY_CND_CD$, PAY_FORM_CD = $V_PAY_FORM_CD$, LST_MDFY_DATM = SYSDATE, MDFYR_ID = 'FTP' WHERE SPPLR_ID IN ( SELECT CP04.SPPLR_ID FROM KEPMDCP01 CP01, KEPMDCP04 CP04 WHERE CP01.ALANC_ID = CP04.ALANC_ID AND CP01.BIZMN_REGST_NO = $V_BIZMN_REGST_NO$ AND CP01.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND CP04.USE_CHK = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT CP05.SPPLR_ID FROM KEPMDCP01 CP01, KEPMDCP05 CP05 WHERE CP01.ALANC_ID = CP05.ALANC_ID AND CP01.BIZMN_REGST_NO = $V_BIZMN_REGST_NO$ AND CP01.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND CP05.USE_CHK = 'Y' ) AND USE_CHK='Y'
